title: GPU prices are approaching 2.5x their launch cost. Asus and Gigabyte just made it official with a second 2026 price hike.
excerpt: Asus and Gigabyte hiked RTX 50-series prices by $96 to $666 per card. One buyer's $4,429 RTX 5090 order was cancelled mid-purchase. The DRAM crisis is the cause.
content_html:
TL;DR

Asus and Gigabyte raised prices across all RTX 50 and AMD Radeon GPUs. The RTX 5090D V2 jumped up to $666. A buyer’s $4,429 order was cancelled because Asus could no longer supply at that price. The same card now lists at $4,982.

Asus and Gigabyte have raised prices across their entire Nvidia RTX 50-series and AMD Radeon RX 9000 GPU lineups, the second round of increases this year. The biggest hit lands on the RTX 5090D V2, which received channel price increases of $592 from Gigabyte and $666 from Asus. The RTX 5080 rose $207-$222, the RTX 5070 Ti went up $222-$252, and even the entry-level RTX 5060 Ti climbed $74-$104. AMD cards are not spared: the Radeon RX 9070 XT jumped $170 at Asus.

One cancelled order illustrates the market. A buyer placed a $4,429 order for an Asus ROG Astral RTX 5090 through Nvidia’s own marketplace. Asus told Nvidia it could no longer supply the card at that price, and the order was cancelled outright. The same card now lists at $4,982, nearly 2.5 times Nvidia’s original Founders Edition price. Both companies already raised prices in January, blaming the DRAM and NAND memory shortage. This second round confirms the costs are still climbing.

The AI boom is killing the cheap smartphone by diverting memory production to data centres, and the same shortage is now making GPUs unaffordable at every tier. Even legacy cards like the RTX 3050 and RTX 3060, which Nvidia reintroduced specifically to offer cheaper options during the crisis, received price increases of $44 and $141. When a manufacturer cancels a customer’s order because it cannot honour the price between placement and fulfilment, the supply chain is broken in real time.

GPU prices on this generation have been creeping toward double their launch cost. Apple already raised Mac and iPad prices globally due to the same memory shortage, and the pressure is now hitting every product category with a processor and memory inside it. The best time to buy a GPU was before the shortage started. The second-best time was yesterday. Tomorrow will be more expensive.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

华硕和技嘉提高了所有 RTX 50 和 AMD Radeon GPU 的价格。 RTX 5090D V2 涨至 666 美元。 一位买家的 4,429 美元订单被取消，因为华硕无法再以该价格供货。 同一张卡现在的售价为 4,982 美元。

华硕和技嘉已经提高了整个 Nvidia RTX 50 系列和 AMD Radeon RX 9000 GPU 系列的价格，这是今年的第二轮涨价。 最大的打击是 RTX 5090D V2，技嘉的渠道价格上涨了 592 美元，华硕的渠道价格上涨了 666 美元。 RTX 5080 上涨了 207-222 美元，RTX 5070 Ti 上涨了 222-252 美元，甚至入门级 RTX 5060 Ti 也上涨了 74-104 美元。 AMD 卡也未能幸免：华硕的 Radeon RX 9070 XT 价格上涨了 170 美元。

一份被取消的订单说明了市场的情况。 一位买家通过 Nvidia 自己的市场下了价值 4,429 美元的华硕 ROG Astral RTX 5090 订单。 华硕告诉英伟达，它不能再以这个价格供应该卡，并且订单被彻底取消。 该卡现在的售价为 4,982 美元，几乎是 Nvidia 最初 Founders Edition 价格的 2.5 倍。 两家公司都已在一月份提高了价格，原因是 DRAM 和 NAND 内存短缺。 第二轮确认成本仍在攀升。

人工智能的繁荣正在将内存生产转移到数据中心，从而扼杀廉价智能手机，而同样的短缺现在使得各个层面的 GPU 都变得难以承受。 即使是 Nvidia 专门重新推出的 RTX 3050 和 RTX 3060 等传统显卡，以在危机期间提供更便宜的选择，价格也上涨了 44 美元和 141 美元。 当制造商因为无法履行下达和履行之间的价格而取消客户的订单时，供应链就会实时中断。

这一代的 GPU 价格已经攀升至其发布成本的两倍。 由于同样的内存短缺问题，苹果已经在全球范围内提高了 Mac 和 iPad 的价格，现在压力已经降临到每一个包含处理器和内存的产品类别上。 购买 GPU 的最佳时机是在短缺开始之前。 第二好的时间是昨天。 明天会更贵。
